archive.catalogue_description: Description CimesTwo, YaPh1l & veKtik present Hello, my name is CimesTwo and this is my first custom zombie map for public. Fearless is only a fun map… a very hard fun map. It contains many extras: traps, autoturret, new perks & powerups and still more. Enjoy my Map The Features: -Scripts by YaPh1l * 2 new powerups * Higher powerup limit per round * Fixed Jugger-Nog and Wunderwaffe * Wunderwaffe can kill more zombies than normal * Easter Egg * 8 Songs in the music box * Ambient effect: sparks * 4 original perks * Black Ops Perks by bamskater33 * New perk symbols * New weapons Nambu, Tokarev, Walther & Arisaka (from multiplayer) thanks to knzombiemaster & ZK Studios for his help * Buyable ending (Team Teleporter) by www.zombiemodding.com/index.php?topic=8273.0 * Zombie Counter by Mrhankey91 * Pack-a-Punch weapons in the Mystery-Box * Players start with 80 points * New Zombie animation (multiplayer) * Zombie Dogs * Many fx effects (sparks, fire & insects) Contact: Mapper: CimesTwo (youtube.com/CimesTwo) Scripter: YaPh1l (youtube.com/YaPh1l) Publisher: veKtik (youtube.com/veKtik) Special thanks: -Knzombiemaster -Kampfschaf -Tom_bmx -Zombiemodding.com

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
